rationale: Identity was properly verified using full name and ZIP. However, the agent executed an order-changing action (exchange) without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation from the user, which the policy requires. The agent also proceeded with an exchange using specific item IDs and provided details (new item battery life, refund amount) that are not supported by the visible tool outputs; the exchange tool response did not clearly confirm success or show the refund calculation. Additionally, the agent did not explicitly verify order/item eligibility (e.g., delivery status) via read-only inspection before committing the change. These issues constitute policy violations despite the user’s intent being clear, so the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
